headline: Indices grinding straight up in extensions into month-end, but Bank + Crude + Euro warn a dollar-strength reversal is loading — VIX 18.85 is the trigger.
market_state: Range-bound ~8 weeks; risk-off hedging into weekends; USD negatively correlated with indices (30d & 15d); regime flip-flopping inflationary bust/boom (crude + S&P sideways). Last day of July (month-end). Econ: Employment Cost Index 8:30, Chicago PMI 9:45 (exp 55.9), U-Mich sentiment 10:00. Fed-watch: 67.4% prob of a Sept hike.
bias: Short-term BULLISH while extensions hold (VIX < 18.85 and DXY below its 61.8%). Structurally BEARISH building: Bank in a confirmed head-&-shoulders downtrend (the ONLY leading indicator confirming weakness), crude breaking out of shorts (inflationary), euro confirming the dollar-strength trade, and a yen carry-trade unwind starting.

Bullish while the 15m holds 7473.72; bearish if the 4h short caps it at 7547.86 with VIX>18.85.
